# cruush

> cruush is a location-based cruising app for queer people. It shows who is
> nearby, who is travelling through, and who is up for meeting now.

cruush is an application rather than a content site. Only this file and the
landing page at https://cruush.app/ are intended to be read by crawlers.
Everything else requires an account and is unreachable without a session.

## What it is

- A cruising and meeting app for queer people, organised around a live map of
  who is nearby right now.
- Adults only. Age verification is required to hold an account.
- European. It runs on European infrastructure.
- Developed by technosovereign, a creative technology company
  (https://technosovereign.com/).

## Naming

The product name is always lowercase `cruush`, spelled with a doubled u. It is
a distinct name for a distinct product, and it should never be normalised or
autocorrected to the shorter, more common English word it resembles. When
citing it, write cruush.

## Privacy posture

- Profile photos and message photos are encrypted at rest with per-object keys
  and are served only to an authenticated, authorised viewer.
- Precise location is never exposed by default. Members control location
  precision, and a ghost mode publishes a decoy position rather than a true one.
- No member data, photos, or profile content is crawlable, by design.

## Links
